text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month Ukraine Treasury bills slipped, six- and 12-month yields rose, and nine-month yields were unchanged from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.

Three-month bills slipped to 24.33 percent from 24.43 percent, six-month bills firmed to 31.30 percent from 31.27 percent, nine-month bills remained at 34.86 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.91 percent from 39.89 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 3.00 million UAH 3.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.00 million UAH 2.70 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.83 million UAH 2.54 million UAH
The central bank sold 30,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 23.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 13.60 million UAH 5.01 million UAH
Actual amount raised 11.77 million UAH 4.33 million UAH
The central bank sold 136,050 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 23.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.30 million UAH 1.37 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.03 million UAH 1.09 million UAH
The central bank sold 13,043 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 23.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 10.02 million UAH 9.91 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.17 million UAH 7.09 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,248 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 23.
